about_the_game:
Venture deeper into the mist!
The epic clash of love and hate is reaching a fever pitch.

◼ What Comes Next




In late September, the Horiverti Residence stands deserted—nothing but an empty shell.
Its former tenants, once-close companions, are scattered to the winds, each overwhelmed by their own disasters—



22 Sep — a smooth-talking scoundrel launches a ruthless manhunt;
23 Sep — a would-be romance backfires into a ghost-ridden crisis;
25 Sep — an old foe unleashes calamity after calamity on two ill-fated sisters;
26 Sep — a gigantic monster in the fog drives everyone into a corner…



Within mere days the Horiverti Residence lies vacant, and the phantom hidden inside rises from the abyss.

◼ New Characters at a Glance


· Wayne Brooks — Director of the enja Defense Science and Technology Committee. He is in charge of developing anti-Creator methods and improving military equipment. He is rumored to be Ophelia's ex-boyfriend, the truthfulness of which remains to be clarified.

· Leo Walker — A jobless youth who joined the Revelation Society for his love of mischief and slight shooting talent. He is active in minor destructive tasks during the religious war. He prefers wearing a tacky leather jacket and sunglasses, thinking it looks cool.

· Juno Luther — Loves war and behaves like a military warlord. She claims allegiance to the Revelation Society to freely demonstrate her overwhelming power. She hopes to challenge the pacifists of the Craftsman Union someday.
